subtitle: What happens when a row doesn't parse cleanly

eyebrow: What an error actually looks like
caption: A dropped-table error here — but a bad COPY INTO surfaces the same way.

annotations.label: Error code, then the real message

code:
COPY INTO target_table
FROM @my_stage
FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = 'csv_ff')
ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE';  -- default is ABORT_STATEMENT
caption: ABORT_STATEMENT fails loud by default; CONTINUE skips just the bad row.

code:
COPY INTO target_table
FROM @my_stage
FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = 'csv_ff')
VALIDATION_MODE = 'RETURN_ERRORS';
caption: Reports every row that would fail — loads nothing into the table.
Copy History sits right under Query History — its own tab for load status specifically.
COPY_HISTORY needs a table name and time window by design.
